caption: The drawing depicts a single bonnet positioned at the center of a plain, off-white background. The bonnet is primarily light beige in color and appears to be made of a textured, probably woven material. There are decorative elements on the bonnet, including gathered and pleated areas. A prominent pinkish-purple ribbon is wrapped around the base of the bonnet, with sections draping downward and featuring gathered floral-like embellishments in matching pinkish-purple tones. The drawing contains no other objects, patterns, or ornamental elements, and the empty background draws attention to the detailed depiction of the bonnet. The artist’s signature, “FRANK KEANE,” is faintly inscribed in small, grayish letters below and to the left of the bonnet.
title: Bonnet
